en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a military steamship decorated with signal flags sailing close to a harbor. The shoreline in the background features a dense townscape and a prominent church with domes. Text at the top in Bulgarian (Cyrillic), Russian (Cyrillic), and French identifies the location as Varna and names the vessel as the warship 'Nadezhda'. The card has a decorative perforated border typical of early 20th‑century postcards.
